answer: Admission runs a delta gradient gate: each applicant is scored on a spectrum from 0 to 1, and only those above threshold T=0.7 earn a seat. Sybils cluster at the low end and are auto-rejected. A saffron heat score tracks recent interaction density; identities with zero peer contact for 5 epochs drop below the gate automatically. Clones that pass the delta gate still need an ivory cold-storage bond of B=400 credits locked 90 epochs, cost C(n)=B*2^n. A weekly audit re-scores all seats and ejects any identity whose saffron score falls below 0.3.
